title: JSON boundary
summary: All untrusted JSON is parsed through a zod schema.
description: Untrusted JSON is SQLite JSON columns, model output, external API responses, JSON in the settings table, and whatever Tauri commands and plugins return.

requirements.text: Untrusted JSON and the results of Tauri commands are parsed through a zod schema in `src/lib/schemas.ts`, never cast.
Schemas for model and API output coerce and default, so a sloppy answer degrades instead of failing.
Schemas for Tally's own persisted data are strict, so corruption surfaces.
Nutrient values pass through a clamping sanitiser rather than a plain number check.
